name: Cloud 9 | 1g Live Rosin Diamond Disposable | Red Apple Rush
description:
Red Apple Rush

Crisp red apple meets light spice. Euphoric head high with a smooth finish that gives you that mental snap and bright energy, like a cold bite of apple at sunrise.

Flavor Profile: Juicy Red Apple · Sweet

Effects: Creative · Energetic · Focused

Primary Terpenes: Limonene, ß-Caryophyllene, Myrcene
